_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard. One core.wbx is five machines and each takes its own kind of file, so each gets its own slot: choosing Game Gear offers Game Gear cartridges and nothing else, and Sega CD is the machine that takes discs. Exactly one slot is exposed at a time, because exactly one machine is chosen - the exposedWhen conditions do the whole job, and the machine comes from the project rather than from a file name.

slots.title: Cartridge
slots.help: The Mega Drive / Genesis cartridge rom. A cartridge for another console is refused at load - the machine is the project's, not the file's.

slots.title: Sega CD discs
slots.help: Sega CD / Mega CD disc images: a .cue sheet whose referenced track files join the project automatically, or a raw single-track .iso/.bin dump. The first disc is in the drive at boot; the order here is the swap order used by the Previous/Next Disk inputs. Needs the matching region's CD BIOS on the firmware page.
